# Business Archive Management System

A web-based Business Partnership Archive Management System developed
for managing business archival data in the Humber region.

## Features

- User registration and authentication
- Business archive survey and submission
- Archive record management
- Search, filtering and pagination
- Role-based user and administrator access
- Monitoring and alert management
- Email notifications
- RESTful API communication
- System logging and auditing

## Tech Stack

### Frontend
- Vue.js
- JavaScript
- HTML5
- CSS3

### Backend
- Java
- JSP
- Servlets
- RESTful APIs
- Apache Tomcat

### Database
- MySQL
- Redis

## Architecture

The application follows a three-tier architecture:

- Presentation Layer – Vue.js-based web interface
- Business Logic Layer – Java JSP/Servlet backend
- Data Layer – MySQL database with Redis caching

## Core Modules

### User Management
User registration, authentication and role-based access control.

### Archive Management
Submission, storage, retrieval, filtering and management of
business partnership archival records.

### Monitoring and Alerts
Rule-based archive monitoring with email notifications.

### Administration
Administrative dashboard for managing users, archives,
alerts and system activity.

## Project Background

This project was developed as a final-year Software Engineering
project at the University of Hull.

The system focuses on providing a modular and extensible platform
for managing business partnership archival information in the
Humber region.
